# Mergen Interactive

> Independent app studio from Antalya, Türkiye (Mustafa Kanlı). Apps: RecipeLink (save recipe videos, meal planning), FlickList (TV show and movie tracking), Mergen Studio (AI brand visuals, web), PomoTails (pomodoro + virtual pet, coming soon). Contact: info@mergeninteractive.com
